req.title: Retrieve task by id
req.statement: The system shall respond to GET /tasks/{task_id} with the corresponding task object.

doc.reasoning: The suite covers: (1) EP positive — retrieve a known existing task and assert every field exactly; (2) NEG — retrieve a non-existent task_id and assert HTTP 404 with exact detail message; (3) BVA — retrieve task_id=1 (lowest boundary) and task_id=20 (highest boundary) to catch off-by-one mutations in ID filtering; (4) NEG — supply a non-integer task_id (string) to assert HTTP 422 unprocessable entity; (5) DT — retrieve a task where completed=true and one where completed=false to assert the boolean field is returned correctly (catches boolean negation mutations); (6) BVA — request task_id=0 (below minimum valid id) to assert 404, and task_id=21 (above seeded max) to assert 404, catching boundary mutations in the NOT FOUND path. All tests use in-process FastAPI TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB seeded from the fixture data, exact-value assertions on status codes and response body fields.

tests.name: test_get_task_existing_returns_200_with_exact_fields
preconditions: Database seeded with 20 tasks as specified
Task id=2 exists with title='Book flight tickets', description='Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.', completed=true
expected: description=='Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.'
trace: R-TASK-008: GET /tasks/{task_id} returns corresponding task object
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from app.database import get_db

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
db_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'test.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSessionLocal = sessionmaker(autocommit=False, autoflush=False, bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

db = TestingSessionLocal()
db.add(models.Task(id=2, title='Book flight tickets', description='Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.', completed=True))
db.commit()
db.close()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSessionLocal()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_get_task_existing_returns_200_with_exact_fields():
    r = client.get('/tasks/2')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 2
    assert body['title'] == 'Book flight tickets'
    assert body['description'] == 'Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.'
    assert body['completed'] == True

test_get_task_existing_returns_200_with_exact_fields()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
